factual_errors_found.description: Regulation cited throughout as 'POJK 36/2025' is actually OJK Regulation No. 36/2024 (POJK 36/2024), implemented via Circular Letter 7/SEOJK.05/2025 effective January 1 2026. The year 2025 in the regulation number refers to the implementing circular, not the regulation itself. All claim citations referencing 'POJK 36/2025' should read 'POJK 36/2024' with implementing SE 7/2025.
factual_errors_found.severity: medium — regulation name and year are wrong but the substantive content (fraud detection mandate, COB requirement, Medical Advisory Board, co-payment rules) appears correctly described based on Nusantara Legal, HHP, and Milliman e-alert sources

factual_errors_found.description: Draft states 'claims ratio reached ~111% for many product lines' for Malaysia 2023 (source 19). Official LIAM data shows the 2023 incurred claims ratio at 65.9% (industry aggregate, per Statista/LIAM). The 101-111% range was cited in a BNM/MOF December 2024 presentation covering 2018-2023, excluding pandemic years — it is NOT the 2023 figure alone. Using 111% as a 2023 figure is a period-conflation error. Correct characterization: claims costs rose 73% cumulatively 2021-2023 while premiums rose 21%; the 101-111% range represents the multi-year band across 2018-2023.
factual_errors_found.severity: high — 111% for 2023 overstates the single-year loss ratio; the incurred claims ratio of 65.9% is a different metric (claims paid / earned premium) from the gross loss ratio on an 'as-charged' basis; the distinction must be noted or the claim is misleading

factual_errors_found.description: VEDIKA staff reduction figures (1,345 → 961) cited from a 2019 study of Sidoarjo Regional Public Hospital. This is a single-hospital study from 6 years ago, used to evidence a system-wide BPJS Kesehatan capability claim. The 45-day to 15-day settlement improvement is from the same 2019 source. Both figures may be valid for that one hospital deployment but cannot be represented as current BPJS system-wide statistics.
factual_errors_found.severity: medium — the directional claim (VEDIKA reduces settlement time) is credible; the specific numbers are stale single-site data

factual_errors_found.description: Malaysia NCD annual healthcare cost 'exceeds RM 9.65 billion' is from a WHO/MOH Malaysia report released August 2022 based on 2017 data. At current medical inflation (12-15% annually 2021-2024), the 2024 equivalent would be materially higher. Outdated-source override applies — source is 7 years stale on underlying data.
factual_errors_found.severity: low — directionally correct but the figure understates current NCD cost burden

gate_reasoning: Stage 3 scores 24% High / 34% Medium / 41% Low across 58 claims. The Low proportion (41%) is meaningfully better than Stage 1 (80% Low) due to stronger primary-source anchoring on key financial metrics (AAJI, LIAM, BNM, Allianz audited results). However, four factual errors require correction before the document is shipped: (1) POJK 36/2025 should be POJK 36/2024 throughout — incorrect regulation year; (2) the '111% claims ratio in 2023' for Malaysia is a period-conflation error (actual 2023 incurred claims ratio per LIAM is 65.9%; the 101-111% band covers 2018-2023 excluding pandemic years); (3) VEDIKA settlement-time statistics (45-day, 15-day, 1,345 staff, 961 staff) are from a 2019 single-hospital study, not current BPJS system-wide data; (4) Malaysia NCD cost RM 9.65 billion is based on 2017 data. Three deep-research priorities can upgrade Low claims to High: (a) direct OJK statistics page fetch for IDR 40.19T GWP and 71.23% claims ratio official data; (b) AMM or BNM primary data to corroborate CodeBlue's GL revocation survey; (c) independent APAC TPA cost benchmark from KPMG/Deloitte/ADB to replace InterPixels AI vendor-sourced figures. The CDM and fraud sections are predominantly Low-confidence and ASSUMED, appropriately limiting actionable claims in those sub-steps. Ship with corrections to factual errors and flagging of three priority deep-research gaps.
